_readme: Ready-made agent actions shown to holders on the Face page. Copy to agent-presets.<chainId>.json, use ONLY verified contract addresses, then run node tools/export-web.mjs <chainId>. risk: 'low' when assets can only stay in the Face (e.g. swaps through a trusted router), 'careful' otherwise. approvals are granted once by the holder (max allowance) before delegating.

_entryFormat.title: Short action name, plain language
_entryFormat.plain: One sentence a non-technical holder understands: what the agent can do and where the result goes.
